references.text: Israel was handed over into the enemy's hand because of their sin, a pattern repeated in the period of the Judges
The Lord's anger and handing over to the enemy as a result of Israel's disobedience
The Israelites hid in caves and mountain clefts during Philistine oppression, a situation similar to that under Midianite rule
The Hebrews hid in caves out of fear of the enemy
A warning from the Mosaic Law that enemies would rule over Israel if they were disobedient
The curse of foreign domination as a consequence of breaking the covenant
The result of Midianite oppression - Israel became extremely poor
Faithful witnesses who wandered in deserts and mountains, in caves and holes in the ground
